_meta.title: Sri Lanka Nationally Determined Contributions 3.0
_meta.supersedes: NDC 2.0 (2021) — 4.5% unconditional / 14.5% conditional by 2030, net zero 2050
_meta.source: DFCC Bank PLC DAE Readiness Pre-Qualified Delivery Partner Terms of Reference, version 21 November 2025, section 1.2
_meta.note: Targets are cumulative over the ten-year period 2026-2035 against a business-as-usual scenario. The reduction target and the removal target are separate commitments and are never added together.
_meta.verify: Figures transcribed from the DFCC ToR. Before any figure here reaches a regulatory submission it should be checked against the NDC 3.0 document as published by the Ministry of Environment.

removal.basis: increase in net carbon removal against BAU, 2026-2035
removal.note: Reported separately from the reduction target. A removal is not a reduction and the two are never summed.

sectorTargets.target: 33.9% GHG emission reduction, while maintaining 70% renewable energy in electricity generation from and beyond 2030
No capacity addition of coal power plants; natural gas introduced to complement renewables for reliability and resource adequacy
Electricity demand reduction of about 30,000 GWh over the ten-year period through energy-efficient equipment, technologies and system improvements
Share of public transport of passengers (bus and rail) from 35% in 2025 to 40% by 2030 and 50% by 2035
Fuel economy and emission performance of the active vehicle fleet improved by 25% by 2035
Circular economy concepts promoted across all industries; eco industrial parks and villages established
Industrial and commercial refrigeration systems converted to low global warming potential technologies
20.8% GHG emission reduction over the ten-year period through integrated activities and management practices, in line with the waste-management hierarchy
Post-harvest losses reduced and value addition of crops improved
Sustainable management of forests, restoration of degraded lands and planting trees outside forests, to increase forest cover to at least 32% by 2035
Conservation and enhancement of blue carbon ecosystems

gesi.requirement: Gender Equity and Social Inclusion (GESI) in all NDCs
gesi.note: GESI is a requirement across every NDC action, not a single sector target. Beneficiary reporting is disaggregated at source rather than estimated after the fact.

nap.title: National Adaptation Plan 2026-2035
nap.note: The revised NAP is aligned with NDC 3.0 adaptation commitments, so national adaptation priorities inform international reporting and finance mobilisation under the Paris Agreement.
nap.status: Based on the working draft of 2025 as described in the DFCC ToR.
